answer: The oasis is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the meadow. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. What survives to the haven is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. The design leans on session-key rotation bound to work, clawed back after a replayed submission, rewards vest against future work.
